verification: Independent all-development natural terminal/state/RNG/timer and outside-NN audit. Fresh original natural starts with saved actions/timing, no imports or resynchronization. Same E94 comparator, then six additional persistent RNG streams via recorded replay, command/identity/keys/two distinct Act3 bosses/Act4/Heart and cleanup audit. limits: Selected development-winning natural action routes only. No losing-route population parity, all-branch parity, learned gain or unseen acceptance. No candidate continuation labels admitted until this gate and the full source gate pass.

entry_verification.scope: Static syntax, frozen inputs and loaded-module identity only; no source outcome audit or original execution.
